t_advice_summary_textbox.text: You have to press the buttons quick as you only have 1.5 seconds to respond. Purple and yellow are good luck but brown is not.

vb_textbox.text: Make sure to press quickly as you only have 1.5 seconds to do so. I personally found that brown and purple would be lucky for around 20 rounds or so and then would switch to being unlucky and then eventually switch back ect. The colour basket your mushrooms come from correspond to which colour gnome you pick but I'm not entirely sure of the significance.
